title: Skyhold Siege
brief: Collect materials, stack and reinforce a vertical refuge, and defend its core against escalating waves.
players: 1–4 LAN cooperative players; local solo campaign

chapters.title: Foundations in the Fog
chapters.story: Orin inherits a broken sky-core and a valley disappearing beneath ash.

chapters.title: Above the Ash
chapters.story: Tala marks the approaches. Higher floors buy time, but unsupported towers will not stand.

chapters.title: The Last Beacon
chapters.story: The last beacon needs a refuge tall and strong enough for the storm crossing.

status: development; build, gameplay, physical controller, multi-machine LAN and Steam release acceptance tracked separately
inspiration: Original characters, names, story and code; genre references are design inspiration only.
